messages: Create and save docs/prds/PRD-report-download.md in <fixture>, English, standard fourteen sections, Draft v1, Product Lead, 2026-11-17. Path and write are authorized. Feature in existing tenant reporting product: admins currently obtain CSVs manually from support. Goal: independent own-tenant completed-report download. One High-priority journey: list, select completed report, download CSV; deny unauthorized access; failed downloads can retry without changing stored data. Scope only existing list/download; exclude report creation, new formats and schema redesign. Requirements: selected CSV download, tenant-isolated list/download and unchanged report data on failure/retry. Confirmed signed client contract requires OIDC-compatible sign-in, no identity redesign. Quality: tenant isolation on every list/download path, verified by release authorization matrix; no new latency/availability commitment. Data: existing completed report, tenant owner and CSV payload; no new entities, retention changes or duplicate storage. Success: at least 9 of 10 admins download independently during a four-week pilot, measured by observed completions. Confirmed baseline is manual support-only with zero self-service completions in current workflow. No empirical assumptions needed. Existing storage/sign-in are available, owned by platform team; failure allows retry. No new dependencies. Tenant means customer isolation boundary; completed report means existing report ready to download. All product choices confirmed; written PRD approval pending. Save/read back/report; do not implement.
expected: Save/read back exactly the authorized file without asking again.
Retain all fourteen sections with substantive content or justified non-applicability.
Preserve confirmed feature scope, privacy/failure behavior, technical constraint and real measurement context.
Use valid linked IDs and truthful Draft status without invented goals/thresholds.
